topArticle.title: Lula wins historic fourth term as Brazilian president in defeat of far-right Flávio Bolsonaro
topArticle.description:
Leftist incumbent Lula says unprecedented comeback was a ‘defeat for denialism’ as Bolsonaro refuses to accept election result

Lula wins election in stunning comeback – live updates

Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the Brazilian president, has staged a dramatic election fightback, defeating his far-right opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, to claim a historic fourth term in power.
With 100% of votes counted the 80-year-old leftist received 4.4m votes more than Bolsonaro, with a 51.79% share to his 45-year-old rival’s 48.21%. However, soon after Brazil’s electoral authority confirmed Lula’s victory, Bolsonaro refused to concede defeat and asked for the results to be annulled.

topArticle.title: US forces accused of ‘weaponising’ Somalia’s floods by trapping women and children in the path of El Niño
topArticle.description:
Exclusive: Coordinated airstrikes on territory held by al-Shabaab are driving the civilian population to find refuge alongside a river where rising water levels are a threat to safety. Is it a deliberate military strategy?
The water was rising rapidly. It had already reached Cayni Ali’s waist. Her home, five metres from the flooded River Juba in southern Somalia, never stood a chance. There was nowhere to go. Ali’s city of Jilib was under attack. Repeated airstrikes, said the mother of six, were pinning its population beside the rising river.
“The drones come all the time,” said the 27-year-old. “We hear them constantly. They kill animals, civilians. The town is big but destruction is everywhere.”

topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルはいかにして工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除しようと戦っているか
topArticle.summary: 健康擁護団体がより厳しい管理を求める中、エクアドルは工業用トランス脂肪酸の規制と施行の間のギャップに直面しながら、食品からの排除に取り組んでいる。

topArticle.title: A shark went astray and captured Korea's heart - will she finally make it back to sea?
topArticle.description: More than a million people flocked to Busan to catch a glimpse of the female dusky shark they called Bukangi.
topArticle.titleJa: 迷い込んだサメが韓国の人々の心を掴む ― 彼女はついに海に戻れるのか？
topArticle.summary: 釜山に迷い込んだメジロザメ「ブカンギ」を一目見ようと、100万人以上が訪れた。果たして海に帰れるか注目されている。

topArticle.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
topArticle.description: One person has died after being swept away by waves in Taiwan's Liuqiu island, authorities say.
topArticle.titleJa: 台風チャンピーが台湾を閉鎖、数百便が欠航
topArticle.summary: 台風チャンピーの影響で台湾では数百便が欠航し、離島では波に流され1人が死亡したと当局が発表した。

topArticle.title: Zimbabwe initiates safeguard investigation on pasta products
topArticle.description: On 22 October 2026, Zimbabwe notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 18 September 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of certain pasta products.
topArticle.titleJa: ジンバブエがパスタ製品のセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: ジンバブエは2026年10月22日、一部のパスタ製品輸入に対するセーフガード調査を2026年9月18日に開始したことをWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: The Philippines launches safeguard investigation on pork
topArticle.description: On 21 October 2026, the Philippines notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of pork.
topArticle.titleJa: フィリピンが豚肉のセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: フィリピンは2026年10月21日、豚肉輸入に対するセーフガード調査を2026年10月9日に開始したことをWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
topArticle.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
topArticle.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
topArticle.summary: 政府調達委員会は、東ティモールの政府調達協定（GPA）加盟交渉開始に必要な文書提出を歓迎した。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカルが一部菓子製品のセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは2026年10月12日、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子輸入に対するセーフガード調査を2026年10月9日に開始したことをWTOに通知した。
